propositions: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError during evidence gathering currently propagates and aborts the entire recovery, discarding all partial evidence instead of allowing remaining criteria to complete
Budget exhaustion in one evidence run is a per-criterion safeguard boundary condition that should be caught and marked with a content-free placeholder, not treated as fatal to aggregate recovery

Recovery must catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError per criterion, substitute a diagnostic placeholder entry marked exhausted=true, and continue with remaining criteria

Recovery should only raise CompletionRecoveryError when zero criteria produce evidence, not when a single criterion exhausts; the finalizer receives N evidence entries and renders per-criterion verdicts

The exhausted placeholder must be content-free (naming only the failure class and usage counters) and never readable as affirmative evidence, forcing the finalizer to mark that criterion unmet or indeterminate
